en.fail.keyword-missing-in-description: A fresh audit finds the keyword in the meta description.
en.fail.keyword-missing-in-h1: A fresh audit finds the keyword in the H1.
en.fail.keyword-missing-in-title: A fresh audit finds the keyword in the title.
en.fail.keyword-stuffing: A fresh audit shows the keyword density below 3%.
en.fail.local-nap-inconsistent: The structured-data phone and address equal the ones shown on the page, on every page.
en.fail.local-no-phone-link: The phone number is a tel: link on the pages that show it.
en.fail.long-sentences: A fresh audit shows fewer sentences above 25 words.
en.fail.og-image-relative-url: A fresh audit sees an absolute og:image URL.
en.fail.og-image-too-small: A fresh audit reads an og:image of at least 1200x630.
en.fail.og-image-unreachable: A fresh audit fetches the og:image with status 200 and a valid image.
en.fail.og-image-wrong-ratio: A fresh audit reads an og:image with a ratio near 1.91:1.
en.fail.readability-hard: A fresh audit shows a readability score above the 'very difficult' range.
en.fail.twitter-card-missing: A fresh audit finds a twitter:card tag.
en.finding.keyword-missing-in-description: A target keyword you gave does not appear in the meta description.
en.finding.keyword-missing-in-h1: A target keyword you gave does not appear in the H1 heading.
en.finding.keyword-missing-in-title: A target keyword you gave does not appear in the title tag.
en.finding.keyword-stuffing: A target keyword makes up more than 3% of the words. Google publishes no density rule; this is a readability warning.
en.finding.local-nap-inconsistent: The business name, address or phone number is not the same everywhere on the site (a different number or address, not just a different spelling).
en.finding.local-no-phone-link: A phone number is shown as plain text but no link starts the call on a phone (no tel: link).
en.finding.long-sentences: More than 30% of the sentences are longer than 25 words.
en.finding.og-image-relative-url: The og:image is a relative URL. Most social crawlers need an absolute URL (https://...).
en.finding.og-image-too-small: The og:image is smaller than 1200x630 pixels; large cards may be shown small or cropped.
en.finding.og-image-unreachable: The og:image URL does not return an image (error, missing file or unreachable). Social networks will show no picture.
en.finding.og-image-wrong-ratio: The og:image does not have the usual 1.91:1 ratio; platforms may crop it.
en.finding.readability-hard: The text is very difficult to read by the Flesch / Atesman score (long sentences and long words).
en.finding.schema-context-not-https: A JSON-LD block uses "http://schema.org" as its @context. The reference recommends "https://schema.org".
en.finding.schema-deprecated-type: A JSON-LD block uses a type whose Google rich result was retired. The markup is harmless but no longer brings a rich result.
en.finding.schema-faq-rich-result-retired: The page has FAQPage markup. Google has retired FAQ rich results, so it no longer produces a search feature. Reported for information only.
en.finding.schema-invalid-date: A JSON-LD block contains dates that are not in ISO 8601 format.
en.finding.schema-missing-key-properties: A JSON-LD entity lacks properties the schema reference lists as key properties for its type. These are recommendations, not guaranteed requirements.
en.finding.schema-missing-type: A JSON-LD block has no @type, so it does not say what kind of thing it describes.
en.finding.schema-offer-missing-fields: An Offer lacks price, priceCurrency or availability, which the reference recommends.
en.finding.schema-placeholder-values: A JSON-LD block contains placeholder-looking values such as [Business Name], lorem ipsum or "your company".
en.finding.schema-product-missing-fields: A Product block lacks name, image or offers, the minimum the reference gives for merchant listings.
en.finding.schema-relative-url: A JSON-LD block contains URLs that are not absolute. The reference recommends absolute URLs.
en.finding.twitter-card-missing: There is no twitter:card tag. X/Twitter falls back to Open Graph but shows a small card by default.
en.lead.keyword-missing-in-description: Click-through rate for the keyword in Search Console.
en.lead.keyword-missing-in-h1: Impressions and average position for the keyword in Search Console.
en.lead.keyword-missing-in-title: Impressions and average position for the keyword in Search Console.
en.lead.keyword-stuffing: Time on page and manual read-through.
en.lead.local-nap-inconsistent: Consistency of the business details across your profiles and directories.
en.lead.local-no-phone-link: Taps on the phone number in the mobile report of your analytics.
en.lead.long-sentences: Bounce rate and time on page of this page.
en.lead.og-image-relative-url: Link preview in a social share debugger.
en.lead.og-image-too-small: How the link looks when shared in a chat or social post.
en.lead.og-image-unreachable: Link preview in a social share debugger.
en.lead.og-image-wrong-ratio: How the link looks when shared in a chat or social post.
en.lead.readability-hard: Time on page and scroll depth in your analytics.
en.lead.twitter-card-missing: How the link looks when shared on X.
en.rec.keyword-missing-in-description: Mention the keyword in the description; Google bolds matching words in the snippet.
en.rec.keyword-missing-in-h1: Make the H1 describe the page's topic using the keyword naturally.
en.rec.keyword-missing-in-title: Work the keyword (or a close variant that keeps its words) into the title, near the start.
en.rec.keyword-stuffing: Reword the text so the keyword reads naturally; use synonyms and related terms.
en.rec.local-nap-inconsistent: Pick one canonical phone number and address, and use it in the structured data, the visible text and the footer of every page.
en.rec.local-no-phone-link: Wrap the phone number in a link such as <a href="tel:+90...">, using the international format.
en.rec.long-sentences: Split the longest sentences; one idea per sentence reads better.
en.rec.og-image-relative-url: Write the full address, including https:// and the host name.
en.rec.og-image-too-small: Provide an image of at least 1200x630 pixels (about 1.91:1).
en.rec.og-image-unreachable: Point og:image to a public, absolute image URL that answers with status 200.
en.rec.og-image-wrong-ratio: Export the image at 1200x630 (1.91:1) and keep key content in the centre.
en.rec.readability-hard: Use shorter sentences and plainer words; split long paragraphs. Aim for the level of your audience.
en.rec.schema-deprecated-type: Do not add new markup of this type for search benefit; keep or remove the existing block deliberately.
en.rec.schema-faq-rich-result-retired: Keep the markup if it is accurate; do not add new FAQPage markup for Google search benefit. Use QAPage for genuine user Q&A pages.
en.rec.schema-invalid-date: Write dates as ISO 8601 (for example 2026-11-13 or 2026-11-13T10:00:00+03:00).
en.rec.schema-missing-key-properties: Add the missing properties where the real data exists.
en.rec.schema-missing-type: Add a valid @type to every described entity.
en.rec.schema-offer-missing-fields: Add price, priceCurrency and availability to the Offer.
en.rec.schema-placeholder-values: Replace placeholder values with the real data.
en.rec.schema-product-missing-fields: Add name, image and offers (with price, priceCurrency and availability).
en.rec.schema-relative-url: Use absolute URLs (https://...) in url, image, logo and similar properties.

tr.finding.keyword-missing-in-description: Verdiğiniz hedef anahtar kelime meta açıklamada geçmiyor.
tr.finding.keyword-missing-in-h1: Verdiğiniz hedef anahtar kelime H1 başlığında geçmiyor.
tr.finding.keyword-missing-in-title: Verdiğiniz hedef anahtar kelime title etiketinde geçmiyor.
tr.finding.keyword-stuffing: Hedef anahtar kelime kelimelerin %3'ünden fazlasını oluşturuyor. Google bir yoğunluk kuralı yayınlamıyor; bu bir okunabilirlik uyarısıdır.
tr.finding.local-nap-inconsistent: İşletme adı, adresi veya telefonu sitenin her yerinde aynı değil (yazım farkı değil, farklı bir numara veya adres).
tr.finding.local-no-phone-link: Telefon numarası düz metin olarak gösteriliyor ancak telefonda aramayı başlatan bir bağlantı (tel:) yok.
tr.finding.og-image-relative-url: og:image göreli bir URL. Çoğu sosyal ağ tarayıcısı mutlak URL (https://...) ister.
tr.finding.og-image-too-small: og:image 1200x630 pikselden küçük; büyük kartlar küçük veya kırpılmış görünebilir.
tr.finding.og-image-unreachable: og:image URL'si görsel döndürmüyor (hata, eksik dosya veya erişilemiyor). Sosyal ağlar görsel göstermez.
tr.finding.og-image-wrong-ratio: og:image olağan 1,91:1 orana sahip değil; platformlar kırpabilir.
tr.finding.readability-hard: Metin Flesch / Ateşman puanına göre okunması çok zor (uzun cümleler ve uzun kelimeler).
tr.finding.schema-context-not-https: Bir JSON-LD bloğu @context olarak "http://schema.org" kullanıyor. Referans "https://schema.org" önerir.
tr.finding.schema-deprecated-type: Bir JSON-LD bloğu, Google zengin sonucu kaldırılmış bir tür kullanıyor. İşaretleme zararsızdır ama artık zengin sonuç getirmez.
tr.finding.schema-faq-rich-result-retired: Sayfada FAQPage işaretlemesi var. Google FAQ zengin sonuçlarını kaldırdı, bu yüzden artık bir arama özelliği üretmez. Yalnızca bilgi amaçlı bildirilir.
tr.finding.schema-invalid-date: Bir JSON-LD bloğu ISO 8601 biçiminde olmayan tarihler içeriyor.
tr.finding.schema-missing-key-properties: Bir JSON-LD varlığında, schema referansının türü için anahtar özellik olarak listelediği özellikler eksik. Bunlar öneridir, garanti edilmiş zorunluluk değildir.
tr.finding.schema-missing-type: Bir JSON-LD bloğunda @type yok, bu yüzden neyi tanımladığını söylemiyor.
tr.finding.schema-offer-missing-fields: Bir Offer'da referansın önerdiği price, priceCurrency veya availability eksik.
tr.finding.schema-placeholder-values: Bir JSON-LD bloğu [Business Name], lorem ipsum veya "your company" gibi yer tutucu görünümlü değerler içeriyor.
tr.finding.schema-product-missing-fields: Bir Product bloğunda name, image veya offers eksik; referansın satıcı listeleri için verdiği asgari alanlar bunlardır.
tr.finding.schema-relative-url: Bir JSON-LD bloğu mutlak olmayan URL'ler içeriyor. Referans mutlak URL önerir.
tr.finding.twitter-card-missing: twitter:card etiketi yok. X/Twitter Open Graph'a döner ama varsayılan olarak küçük kart gösterir.

tr.lead.keyword-missing-in-h1: Search Console'da kelime için gösterim ve ortalama konum.

tr.lead.long-sentences: Bu sayfanın hemen çıkma oranı ve sayfada geçirilen süre.
